13.description: A public hearing was held for a proposed Official Community Plan amendment and rezoning at 702 and 706 Victoria Avenue to permit a six-story residential building.

chips.text: First reading passed (9-0)
9 for, 0 against
Councillor Dubois questioned short-term rental rules and unit ownership.

9 for, 0 against
The rezoning changes the properties from RM3 to RM5 zoning.

18.description: Saskatoon may allow six-unit dwellings on corner lots in Transit Development Areas, increasing density from four units per lot.

chips.text: First reading passed (9-0)
